_comment: Committed expectations for ControlLoop issue #103 (E10.7), asserted by
the reference-scenario workflow. Every value was produced by a real
`controlloop gate` run against this branch, never hand-written.

reduced capability by material class needs a MaterialChangeSummary,
which needs both graphs, which needs the merge-base path -- and that
